title: moduleScenarioReviews
responsibility: Validate and apply reviewed scenario evidence declarations while preserving original states and test targets, returning superseded diagnostics.

inputs.name: moduleScenarioReviews.scenarios
inputs.description: Mutable manifests from the exact source revision; matching scenarios receive reviewed evidence without changes to states or test targets.

inputs.name: moduleScenarioReviews.reviews
inputs.description: Source-bound module reviews; each requested scenario must exist, cover the reviewed module and have only one declaration in this batch.

outputs.name: moduleScenarioReviews
outputs.description: Original scenario validation diagnostics superseded by the reviewed declarations, for removal from the cached source issue list.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for missing, uncovered or duplicate scenarios, or invalid evidence declarations such as unknown states or viewports.
